data.title: Senior Data Engineer
data.description:
We are expanding the engineering team responsible for a modern cloud data platform serving customers across the United Kingdom.

Responsibilities

You will design reliable ingestion services, model complex datasets, automate deployments, and partner with software teams on well-defined data contracts. You will also mentor colleagues and take part in an on-call rota.

Experience

Strong Python and SQL skills are essential. Experience with distributed processing, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and production monitoring is important. Experience in a regulated environment would be useful but is not required.
